Asha R: Quick check-in: do we prefer a tiny multi-lang contracts package or a live negotiation endpoint for routing/telemetry headers?

Tom V: Package. Fewer runtime surprises and faster hotfixes.

Gwen H: Agreed, but we must keep it tiny: only constants + normalization helpers. No network calls.

Asha R: Good. Distribution: internal registries first, public later. CI auto-build for py/ts/go.

Devex Raj: Console needs fallback UI for unknown route IDs: show id + "Unknown policy" label and date of rollout. Also add csv export.

Tom V: Telemetry names: suggest `redwood.quota.requested_tokens` and `redwood.quota.tenant_id` exported from package.

build-bot: CI triggered: contracts-crossbuild (matrix: py, ts, go) run at 2026-03-24T09:00Z.

Gwen H: Action items: Tom to open repo skeleton; Asha + Gwen to write compatibility policy draft; Devex Raj to mock console fallback. Short sync Friday. :thumbsup:
